videos.title: Asian Network Motivation with Aina
videos.description: Aina explores kismet, destiny and life's unexpected twists, reflecting on taking chances, trusting the journey and accepting that not everything is meant to be.

videos.title: Asian Network Breakfast with Hawa
videos.description: Hawa brings a proper Saturday mix of big tunes starting with Mumzy Stranger, Simar and Aastha Gill.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified with Hawa
videos.description: Hawa brings Asian Network Certified for your Saturday spinning Arijit Singh, Ezu and Vishal Dadlani with The Nooran Sisters, Pitbull and Jay Sean.

videos.title: Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa wraps up November with big bangers, Bollywood birthdays and a Popcorn Puzzle - but will you be able to piece together the clues to reveal the mystery film.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified Throwbacks with Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa plays big anthems and tunes you haven't heard in ages. Bollywood, Bhangra, hip-hop, R&B, UK garage and British Asian beats all mashed up.

videos.title: Gura
videos.description: Gura is back bringing you three hours of great music, and she wants to know is Black Friday really a bargain.

videos.title: Panjabi Hit Squad
videos.description: Panjabi Hit Squad soundtrack your Saturday nights with the biggest and best tunes, Asian anthems and mixes.

videos.title: Pure Spice with DJ Manara
videos.description: Follow the yellow brick what? Manara's gone clean off the map. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Pure Spice - Takeover
videos.description: Classic anthems go head-to-head with today's biggest party tracks. From golden era hip-hop and R&B to modern dancefloor hits! Selected by DJ Jeevan. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Kizzi
videos.description: Kizzi soundtracks your Saturday nights with the biggest and best tunes, Asian anthems and mixes.

videos.title: Asian Network's Club Hit Squad Mix
videos.description: AJD is stepping into the mix this week and bringing the Club Hit Squad experience straight to your speakers with some of the best South Asian Heavy weights.

videos.title: Asian Network's Club Hit Squad Mix
videos.description: The night starts here! Get ready for Asian Network Certified with the ultimate pre-party mix from Dee and Rav.

videos.title: Asian Network Celebrates Rekha
videos.description: Gagan Grewal is celebrating the legacy of Rekha with some of her best music and exclusive interview clips.

videos.title: Gagan's Throwback Bollywood Mix
videos.description: Join Gagan for a Bollywood Throwback Mix that takes you on a journey into the night! Expect iconic tracks featuring the word Raat, from romantic to unforgettable classics.

videos.title: Gagan's Throwback Bollywood Mix
videos.description: Join Gagan for Bollywood melodies about love and life without that special someone! This week it's all about the magic of Tere Bin, Tere Bina and lyrics about feeling incomplete.

videos.title: Bollywood Sing-Along Anthems
videos.description: Nadia Ali serves up Bollywood romance, nostalgia and feel-good favourites, with tracks including Zara Zara, London Thumakda, Chand Chupa Badal Mein and What Jhumka.

videos.title: Asian Network Breakfast with SMASHBengali
videos.description: SMASHBengali plays What's in the Box! A mystery item is hiding inside Smash's purple box, and with clues and help from members of the public, can you guess what's inside.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified Throwbacks with SMASHBengali
videos.description: SMASHBengali brings Asian Network Certified Throwbacks for 60 minutes where Smash rewinds to the biggest anthems from the good times.

videos.title: Asian Network Bollywood with Gagan Grewal
videos.description: Join Gagan Grewal for the biggest Bollywood hits to wrap up November, with heartwarming tunes to brighten your Sunday.

videos.title: Asian Network Celebrates Juhi Chawla
videos.description: Gagan is taking a trip down memory lane to celebrate Bollywood star Juhi Chawla. Expect to hear tracks from her biggest movies like her debut film Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak and more.

videos.title: Asian Network Punjabi with Dipps Bhamrah
videos.description: This week's Bhangra Bounce is all about Next Level Nostalgia bringing together classics from B21, Sahotas, Achanak and Jazzy B.

videos.title: Asian Network's Bengali Entertainment Show with Nadia Ali
videos.description: The home of the freshest Bangla beats from around the world, and more of Nadia's Nostalgia, as she takes another trip into the Asian Network archives.

videos.title: Asian Network's Pakistani Entertainment Show with Kan D Man
videos.description: Join Kan D Man to hear about the latest releases, discover fresh talent and get closer to the musicians behind the music.

videos.title: Asian Network's South Indian and Tamil Entertainment Show with Pritt
videos.description: Asian Network's Tamil and South Indian show with Pritt.

videos.title: Bobby Friction
videos.description: Bobby Schools The Nation on Pasoori by Ali Sethi and Shae Gill. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Asian Network Represents
videos.description: From swallowed jackfruit seeds to itchy palms and chipped plates, Anyeka shares the Bangladeshi superstitions she grew up with, alongside the stories that made her who she is.

videos.title: Asian Network Punjabi: Bhangra Bounce
videos.description: Dipps explores The Beautiful Side of Bhangra with 30 minutes of melodic Punjabi favourites from DCS, Sunidhi Chauhan, Balwinder Safri, Saqi and Miss Pooja.

videos.title: Asian Network Punjabi: Bhangra Bounce
videos.description: Dipps celebrates Rishi Rich with a special Artist Edition of the Bhangra Bounce Mix, featuring Jay Sean, Taz, Mumzy, H-Dhami, Veronica and more.

videos.title: Asian Network Evenings with Gura
videos.description: Gura gets you moving out of work mode and ready for the evening - whether you're cooking, getting ready to hit the gym or just chilling at home.

videos.title: BBC Introducing on Asian Network with Jasmine Takhar
videos.description: Jasmine hears from the BBC Introducing Artist of the Week, Rawz Ali from Wales, and his track Fly Away.

videos.title: Bollywood Sing-Along Anthems
videos.description: Whether it's wedding dance floors, family functions or late-night kitchen discos, Valissa soundtracks the songs that bring generations together the second the beat drops.

videos.title: The Everyday Hustle with Harleen Nottay
videos.description: Harleen Nottay is joined by ethical hacker, Dan G for the BBC's Scam Safe Week 2026.

videos.title: Desi Dancefloor Mix
videos.description: DJ Xak J is stepping into the Desi Dancefloor Mix and blending the slickest sounds. Wherever you are, hit play on the BBC Sounds app or download it and take the vibes with you.

videos.title: Asian Network Breakfast with Nikita Kanda
videos.description: With Black Friday and Cyber Monday, Nikita wants to know what's in your shopping basket and what you bought this weekend. Plus the best music, chat and Kanda Kaos.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified with Nikita Kanda
videos.description: Your daily mix of Bollywood, Bhangra, UK garage, R&B, hip-hop and more with Nikita Kanda.

videos.title: Haroon Rashid
videos.description: Haroon's dropping the week's biggest tunes along with plenty of laughter and chat. Wherever you're listening, Haroon's got the tunes to keep you company.

videos.title: Newsbeat @ 12:45
videos.description: The latest news from around the UK and around the world.

videos.title: Asian Network Bollywood with Haroon Rashid
videos.description: Haroon chats all things Bollywood and reviews the latest films in Rate or Slate. Get in touch with your reviews on what you're watching and hear the biggest Bollywood tracks.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified Throwbacks with Haroon Rashid
videos.description: Haroon Rashid plays big anthems and tunes you haven't heard in ages! From Bollywood, Bhangra, hip-hop, R&B, UK garage and British Asian beats all mashed up.

videos.title: Jaz Singh
videos.description: It's time for Jaz to wrap up your year by giving you the keys to the time machine! He's asking what you'd tell your January 1st self about 2026 if you could go back in time.

videos.title: Newsbeat @ 17:45
videos.description: The latest news from around the UK and around the world.

videos.title: Asian Network Evenings with Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa gets you moving out of work mode and ready for the evening - whether you're cooking, getting ready to hit the gym or just chilling at home.

videos.title: Asian Network's New Music Show with DJ Limelight
videos.description: The best new Asian music from the UK and around the world with MR.O sitting in, including the Coldest Record. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Asian Network Motivation with Aina
videos.description: Get motivated with help from the Asian Network.

videos.title: Asian Network Trending
videos.description: Birmingham-born Easah Suliman captained Pakistan to their first SAFF final in Dhaka. He reflects on winning against Bangladesh, losing to India, and football in South Asia.
